== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used: New page. Players Committee forum topics 3806 (post 52035), 3383 (46989, 47778), 2442 (37471, 37497), 2289 (34893), 4071 (55486), 4063 (55368), 2668 (39624, 40210, 40480), 3659 (49965), 3958 (54048, 54104, 54903), 3974 (54272, 54735, 55369).
=== Build notes ===
* Identity: the handle ecf is Edward Fones. His posts are signed "Edward Carl Fones", a Salem player wrote "Ed Fones(ECF on these boards)" (topic 3958, post 54048), and David Kangas's results post names "Edward Fones" as the 2004 Oregon State Champion.
=== Missing data ===
* Decks for the 2004 Oregon State Championship; his finish in the 2003 Worlds Classic event and his 2004 Worlds results.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The 2004 Oregon runner-up is printed "Noah Frank"; Kangas elsewhere writes "Noah Franke" for a Salem, Oregon TD (topic 3781), so this may be [[Noah Franke]]. Left unlinked.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* His signature title "2004 Oregon State Champ." is not used as the source, because Kangas's results post confirms the win. Earlier notes described him as a Portland player; topic 4504 (post 61728) does not say where he lived, so this was dropped. His 15/16 October 2004 event was described elsewhere as a pre-regional tune-up; post 54903 only asks which day suits players, so that description was dropped. Personal remarks and attacks on named players in topic 4071 (post 55486) were left out.
